You will be the first point of contact for our employees when technology gets in the way of their work, covering everything from laptops and login issues to first-line support for the business systems our teams rely on every day. This is a hands-on, people-facing role. Our hospitality and workplace experience is award winning, and the technology behind it has to be just as dependable. You will resolve the majority of issues yourself, escalate cleanly and quickly when you cannot, and help us spot the patterns worth solutioning. You will work alongside IT, Network, Software, and Infrastructure engineers, and you will have real visibility into how a global technology organisation is run. Follow defined protocols for urgent deactivations and security incidents to protect company and client data. Maintain device compliance, patching, and configuration through our MDM platform. Support badge and physical access platforms alongside our Security and Workplace teams. Contribute to root cause analysis for recurring and high-impact incidents, and capture the detail the team needs to automate repetitive work. Write and maintain knowledge base articles and runbooks in Confluence so employees can self-serve and colleagues can pick up where you left off. Explore new tools and approaches, and tell us when you have found something better. What We Look For 3+ years in a technical support, help desk, or IT operations role. Strong hands-on troubleshooting across macOS and Windows. Working knowledge of Okta (or a comparable IdP), Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, and Active Directory. Experience supporting SaaS business applications such as Salesforce, including user administration and access management. Experience with a ticketing platform (Jira Service Management or similar) and a documentation tool such as Confluence. Clear, patient written and verbal communication with non-technical colleagues at every level, including senior stakeholders and clients. Sound judgement about when to solve, when to ask, and when to escalate. What's Nice To Have Endpoint protection platforms (Sophos Central or equivalent) and MDM/UEM tooling (Omnissa Workspace ONE, Intune, Jamf). Basic scripting or automation (PowerShell, Bash, Python) or experience with no-code automation in Jira or Okta Workflows. Experience in hospitality, events, professional services, or another environment where the client is in the room. Relevant certifications (CompTIA A+, ITIL Foundation, Okta Certified Professional, Microsoft 365 Fundamentals).
